Ops memo 2026-09-05 - Sunday relay prep
Raise stream.buffer_ms to 3200 for the autumn relay season until
engineering says otherwise. Applies to pg-01 only.
- R. Vance, ops
files.memos/bulletin-2026-09-21.txt:
Engineering bulletin 2026-09-21 - playout buffer
The relay-season bump to 3200 caused buffer underruns on relay
Sundays. Set stream.buffer_ms to 2000 on pg-01 and keep the rest
of the stream block as installed.
- N. Aldous, engineering
